title: feat(spec): the Studio hook form offers a refusal's reasons and params
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XNgQVJVHQG8aPco5eaW7Vvs)_

Fixes #33657

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Seat `domain:ui#1` · os-project-manager · card thread `session_01FEkQ5oQHgtkqYPCqstiKir` · claim 6892138272

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 的钩子（hook）表单里，每条拒绝目录条目除了「提示语」和「状态码」，现在还能填「原因」（同一错误码下的多句提示，以 snake_case 原因名为键）和「参数」（提示语里 `{{ 名称 }}` 可以填的名字）。表单定义 `hookForm` 加两行；渲染器本来就能画「嵌套在键值记录里的键值记录」和名称列表。契约复审 S1 之后另有一处渲染器修正：可选的键值记录行删掉最后一条时，现在写成「不存在」，不再写成空对象 `{}`。
- 为什么改：#33214 让拒绝目录支持 `reasons` 和 `params`，但 Studio 表单只给了两项，作者在 Studio 里没法声明这两项能力。
- 风险与回滚：元数据可写内容不变（这两个键本来就合法），只是表单多了两行。实测：在改动前，带 `reasons`/`params` 的目录经 Studio 编辑其他字段后已经能原样保存，本改动后依旧如此；只填提示语和状态码的条目保存结果与今天逐字节相同。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 契约复审 S1 修正（d3ff3bdb）：之前加一条原因再删掉，Studio 会存下 `reasons: {}`；空对象和不写读法不同（空对象会拒绝主体抛出的每个原因，不写则不读原因），而界面上两者看起来一样。同样的问题在上一层：删掉最后一个错误码会存下 `refusals: {}`，它会拒绝主体抛出的每个错误码。现在两处都写成「不存在」；必填的键值记录行（对象的 `fields`）照旧保留 `{}`。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts`（新增的两行）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.hookRefusalReasons-33657.test.tsx`（经真实 Studio 编辑页填写、保存、读回）、`packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`（删掉两条 omit 台账行）。
- 两分钟验证：在 Studio 打开任一带 `refusals` 的钩子，点「编辑」，展开一条错误码：应看到 Key / Message / Status / Reasons / Params 五项；在 Reasons 里加 `plan_locked` 并填一句话，在 Params 里填 `state`，保存后重新打开仍在。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（`hook.form.ts` 随 `@objectstack/spec` 发布，席位先补契约复审记录）。

## What changes

- **The form** (`packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts`). The `refusals` row's entry gains two sub-rows after `message` and `status`:
  - `reasons`: `type: 'record'`, `widget: 'key-only-record'`, with one sub-row `message` (required textarea). A reason entry is `{ message }` and nothing else, with no member that echoes its key, so it takes the same key-only record control the catalogue itself takes. The key rule the control checks is the served schema's own `propertyNames.pattern` for `reasons`, which the spec derives from `HOOK_REFUSAL_REASON_PATTERN`; the form restates no rule.
  - `params`: `type: 'tags'`, the name list control.
  - The entry `message` help text said the sentence is "plain text, with no placeholders". Once `params` is on the same card that is false, so it now says a `{{ name }}` hole fills a declared param. The new rows' help texts recite `HookRefusalSchema`'s own `.describe()` text.
- **The ledger** (`packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`): the two `omit` rows for `hook` / `refusals` / `reasons` and `params` are gone.
- **Drawing the rows needed no renderer change.** Measured on `origin/main` before any edit (below): the console's generic form renderer (`SchemaForm`'s `RecordField`) already draws a key-only record nested inside a key-only record entry, reads each level's key rule from the schema it is handed (`servedRecordKeyPattern`), and draws a `tags` row as the string-tags widget.
- **Removing the last entry of an optional record row writes it absent** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx`, contract review S1, d3ff3bdb). `RecordField.removeItem` emitted `{}` once the last entry went, and nothing on the save path dropped it. `RecordField` now takes `FieldControl`'s `offerUnset` (the key is optional and not a list element, the condition the enum select's "— None —" already uses) and, when that holds, emits an empty map as `undefined`, the form's clear convention. A required row keeps `{}`. See "S1: empty versus absent" below for the forms this reaches.
- **Translations.** The three new rows and the changed help text are translated in the ten locales of `@objectstack/platform-objects`' metadata-form bundles (regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, then the new leaves translated by hand, the same ten the `refusals` row is translated in; a second `--write` dropped the source-hash entries of the translated leaves). The French label "Message" stays a byte copy of the source, as the existing `refusals.message` label already is. The console's zh-CN form labels (`metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`, read by the Pending changes sheet) name the three rows.
- **Census counts.** Three `@objectstack/platform-objects` translation pins count the hook form's enumerated children and the row labels authored in the three hand-translated locales; the three new rows move them from 9 to 12 and from 738 to 741, each with a comment naming the rows.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/33657-hook-form-refusal-reasons-params.md`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console` patch (a widening with `Metadata-protocol: none`; app-shell is private and console's `dist` ships it).

## Measured first (on `origin/main` bd96ec9c, before any edit)

A probe through the real Studio edit page (`MetadataResourceEditPage` for `hook`, the served form `hookForm`, the served schema from `HookSchema`), over a stored hook whose `refusals.CONTRACT_LOCKED` declares `message`, `status: 409`, `params: ['state']` and `reasons.plan_locked.message`:

1. **What the entry offers:** the open entry's labels read `Key*`, `Message*`, `Status`, nothing else. The deciding line is the `refusals` row's `fields` array in `hook.form.ts`, which lists `message` and `status` only; the renderer draws exactly the sub-rows a record row lists (`RecordField` maps its `specs`, the row's `fields`).
2. **Round trip:** a Label edit then Save sent the body with `refusals` byte-identical (`params` and `reasons` kept), and so did an edit of the entry's own `message`. The deciding lines: the page sends the whole draft, and `RecordField`'s `updateItem` writes `{ ...entry, ...patch }`, so members the form does not list are kept. So the card's "may lose them on a Studio edit" did not hold on main; the round-trip pin below now holds it.
3. **Can the renderer draw the shape?** The same probe with a form that adds a nested key-only `reasons` record and a `params` tags row drew `Key / Message / Status / Reasons / Params`, showed `plan_locked` as a nested entry, and no element id was duplicated. A nested `type: 'record'` sub-row goes through the same `FieldRow` → `resolveFieldFace` → `RecordField` path as a top-level one, with the sub-schema from `pickSubSchema`.

## S1: empty versus absent (contract review 6893396284)

Measured through the real Studio edit page on 2238c90f, before the fix (each new pin below red, received shown):

- add `plan_locked` to `CONTRACT_LOCKED`, remove it, edit Label, Save: the entry was stored as `{ message, reasons: {}, status: 409 }`;
- over a stored entry with one reason, remove it, Save: `reasons: {}`, `params` kept;
- remove the only refusal code, Save: `refusals: {}`.

`{}` and absent read differently at both levels. For `reasons`, `hook.zod.ts`'s save-time check refuses every literal reason thrown under a code whose `reasons` is `{}`, and the runtime catalogue faults a computed one; an absent `reasons` does not read the thrown reason. For `refusals`, `{}` is a declared catalogue with no codes, so every code the body throws is refused (and a non-js body is refused outright); an absent catalogue leaves the throws as they were. The screen draws the same empty list either way.

The generic `RecordField` inline face is reached by exactly three form rows across the served forms (`type: 'record'` rows in `packages/spec/src/**/*.form.ts`; no other form declares one, and the other `type: 'record'` hits in the repo are pages):

| Form row | Required? | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| `object` → `fields` | `required: true` | `{}` | `{}` (unchanged, no absent state) |
| `hook` → `refusals` | optional | `{}` (refuses every thrown code) | absent |
| `hook` → `refusals.<CODE>.reasons` | optional | `{}` (refuses every thrown reason) | absent |

So `{}` and absent are not equivalent for the second row either, and the generic fix changes it in the same direction as the finding. That is why the fix is generic and gated on the row being optional, rather than local to the hook form: the form has no per-row way to say "empty means absent", and the `refusals` row has the same defect. Add-then-remove with no other edit now returns the draft to the stored hook, so the page has nothing to save.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.hookRefusalReasons-33657.test.tsx` (new, the real Studio form): the real page with the production registrations, the type row built the way the server builds it (`hookForm` + `z.toJSONSchema(HookSchema, { io: 'input' })`), a stub metadata client as the stored row.
  - an opened refusal entry offers exactly `Key, Message, Status, Reasons, Params`;
  - author a reason (`plan_locked` + its message) and a param (`state`) through the rendered controls, Save: the PUT body's entry is `{ message, status, reasons: { plan_locked: { message } }, params: ['state'] }` and `HookSchema` parses it; then a fresh page over the stored row shows the reason and its message and the `state` chip;
  - a stored catalogue that uses `reasons` and `params` round-trips a Label edit: the body equals the stored hook with the new label;
  - CONTROL: a refusal with only `message` + `status` saves exactly as stored (keys `message`, `status`).
  - S1: add then remove the only reason (plus a Label edit, so there is something to save): the entry is stored as `{ message, status }`, keys exactly those two;
  - S1: remove the last stored reason: the entry is the stored one without `reasons` (`params` kept);
  - S1 CONTROL: add a second reason and remove the first: `reasons` holds the second, as before;
  - S1: remove the only refusal code: the stored hook has no `refusals` key.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.keyOnlyRecord-26835.test.tsx` (the form definition test, new `describe`): `hookForm` declares `reasons` as a key-only record of `{ message }` and `params` as `tags`; the served schema's reason key rule is `HOOK_REFUSAL_REASON_PATTERN.source`; author a reason + param and the value parses as written; a reason key `PLAN_LOCKED` is refused with the served rule and the value does not move; a stored catalogue reloads into the same rows. The file's `addKey` helper now takes the last `Key` box: an open entry draws a second one for its `reasons`, and the catalogue's own box comes after every card. The existing CONTROL there ("a hook authored with two refusals saves a body HookSchema accepts as written") passes unchanged in substance.
- `SchemaForm.keyOnlyRecord-26835.test.tsx`, S1 `describe`: removing the last entry of the optional `refusals` row leaves no `refusals` key and `HookSchema` parses the value; CONTROL: the same row declared `required: true` keeps `refusals: {}`.
- `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`: green without the two `omit` rows (`hook.refusals` offers both keys).

### Ablations

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` on the form source, each leg running the reconciliation test (spec `src`), a spec rebuild, `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/spec MARKER --absent` (ui vitest reads spec from `dist`), and both ui pin files (17 tests). Each restored with blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty; then spec rebuilt and the preflight run without `--absent` found both markers back in `dist` (exit 0), and both pin files were 17/17 green.

- `reasons` row deleted: reconciliation 1 failed / 75 (`hook.refusals: accepted by the Zod but unauthorable in the form … expected [ 'reasons' ] to deeply equal []`); ui 6 failed / 17 (the offer pin, the Studio author-save-reload pin, and all four SchemaForm `reasons`/`params` pins).
- `params` row deleted: reconciliation 1 failed / 75 (`expected [ 'params' ]`); ui 5 failed / 17 (the offer pin, both author pins, the definition pin and the reload pin).
- The round-trip and CONTROL pins stay green under both: they hold behaviour that already held on main, which is what they are for.
- S1, the empty-to-absent arm reverted (`emit` writes the map as given): 4 failed / 23 across the two ui pin files (the SchemaForm optional-row pin and the three Studio S1 pins); the S1 CONTROLs stay green.
- S1, the `offerUnset` gate dropped (every empty map written absent): 1 failed / 15 in `SchemaForm.keyOnlyRecord-26835.test.tsx`, the required-row CONTROL. Both restored by copying the fixed file back; 23/23 green.

## Acceptance notes

- **The premise's second half did not hold on main.** A catalogue using `reasons` / `params` already kept them through a Studio edit (measured above). The new round-trip pin holds that, and nothing in this diff changes it.
- **`params` is not checked in the form.** The tags control accepts any text; a non-identifier is refused at save by `HookSchema` (`A refusal param is an identifier (e.g. state)`), and a `{{ }}` hole over an undeclared name is refused there too. The form restates no rule, as the order asks.
- **Not changed (order's ⛔):** `hook.zod.ts`, the runtime refusal catalogue, the lint rule, any server code.
- **Noted, not filed:** the `refusals` row's help text still ends "JavaScript (L2) bodies only", while since #33641 a `handler` hook may declare `refusals` too. The Studio form authors a `body` hook (the handler row is the collapsed "Legacy handler" text field), so the sentence still describes what this form authors; left as is to keep this diff to the two rows. carrier: none.
